_comment: DDI-CDI -> CDIF DiscoveryDataDescription COMPOSITE profile UML. This config holds no local class declarations; it just composes the constituent profile-module configs (cdifCore + cdifDiscovery + cdifDataDescription). The result mirrors the JSON-Schema allOf at _sources/profiles/cdifCompositeProfile/DiscoveryDataDescription/schema.yaml. Patterns used in the module configs (abstract unions for hasPhysicalMapping / physical-dataset co-typing, anchor stubs with conformsTo annotations) propagate through composes so the composite diagram is consistent with the modules.

targetModel.modelTitle: UML Model for the CDIF DiscoveryDataDescription Composite Profile
targetModel.subTitle: Composes CDIFCore + cdifDiscovery + CDIFDataDescription
targetModel.definition: DiscoveryDataDescription is a CDIF composite profile assembled from three building-block profile modules: cdifCore (the foundational schema:Dataset shape), cdifDiscovery (measurementTechnique, variableMeasured, spatialCoverage, temporalCoverage, hasQualityMeasurement) and cdifDataDescription (variable-level physical types, primary key, statistics, physical mappings on distributions). A metadata record validating against this composite must declare conformance to https://w3id.org/cdif/core/1.0, https://w3id.org/cdif/discovery/1.0, and https://w3id.org/cdif/data_description/1.0.
targetModel.mainPackageDefinition: Composite profile: CDIFCore + cdifDiscovery + CDIFDataDescription assembled.

package.name: Composition
package.definition: Local placeholder package. The composite has no classes of its own beyond what its three composed modules contribute; this package exists so the UML model has at least one non-empty parent for any composite-level constraints added later.

class._comment: Placeholder anchor for composite-level constraints. Carries no real attributes - the composite's content comes entirely from the three composed modules' classes. Will likely be removed when composite-level SHACL / cross-module constraints are explicit.
class.definition: Placeholder for the DiscoveryDataDescription composite. All concrete classes come from the composed modules (CDIFCore, cdifDiscovery, CDIFDataDescription) - this class has no instances.
